meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Guides a refactor, cleanup, or restructure with the right decomposition. Use when the user asks to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把又长又乱的代码拆解整理成清晰好改的模块
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有一堆难维护的老代码,想先理清结构再继续开发
copy.tagline_en: Break tangled code into clean, well-organized modules
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you inherited messy code and want it structured before building further.

howto.what: 当你要求重构代码时,Claude 会先分析代码库、画出依赖关系与影响范围,评估测试覆盖,再生成分步计划,逐步修改并在每步后跑测试和类型检查验证,最后做整体回归检查。
howto.when: 当你说要重构、简化、抽取或现代化某段代码时触发;若目标或范围不明确,它会先反问确认再动手。

say.note: 指定单文件作为重构目标,默认 scope 为 module

say.text: 把 AuthService 类重构一下
say.note: 它会先确认目标和期望结果,再给出计划

say.text: 提取验证逻辑到单独模块 --scope=module
say.note: 按模块范围执行,默认 strategy 为 safe

howto.what_en: When you ask for a refactor, Claude analyzes the codebase, maps dependencies and impact, checks test coverage, plans steps, executes them one by one, and verifies each step with tests and type checks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code. If the target or scope is unclear, it asks clarifying questions before starting.

say_en.note: Target one file; scope defaults to module
It confirms goal and outcome before planning

say_en.text: Extract validation into its own module --scope=module
say_en.note: Runs at module scope; strategy defaults to safe
